also: keep your nose out of it

terms.latin: Tuā quod nihil rēfert, percontārī dēsinās.
terms.gloss: stop asking about what is no concern of yours
evidence: Ter. Hec. 810: Tuā quod nihil rēfert percontārī dēsinās.

terms.latin: Tuā quod nīl rēfert, nē cūrēs.
terms.gloss: don’t trouble yourself with what is no concern of yours
evidence: Plaut. Stich. 319–320: Tuā quod nīl rēfert, nē cūrēs.
terms.comment: Tuā rēfert, it concerns you, takes the ablative feminine of the possessive (Lewis & Short s.v. rēfert).

phrases.latin: Quid reī est? — Tuā quod nihil rēfert percontārī dēsinās.
phrases.english: What’s going on? — Stop asking about what is none of your business.

phrases.latin: Tuā quod nīl rēfert, nē cūrēs.
phrases.english: Don’t trouble yourself with what doesn’t concern you.
